> Abhinav Yadav is a Software Engineer and Cloud & AI Engineer based in Gurgaon, India. He specialises in Azure cloud architecture, AI pipelines, full-stack web development (React, Next.js, Node.js), and creative frontend engineering. He has won multiple national and international hackathons including Microsoft and Smart India Hackathon.

## About

Abhinav Yadav is a passionate Software Engineer with expertise spanning cloud infrastructure, artificial intelligence, and modern web development. He currently works as a Cloud and AI Engineer at Foetron, where he architects Azure infrastructure, builds AI pipelines, and leads hybrid-cloud deployments. He also works as a Prompt Engineer for Outlier on the Google Genesis project (VTT, ATT, ITT).

Key areas of expertise:
- **Cloud Architecture**: Microsoft Azure, hybrid-cloud deployments, Azure OpenAI, Azure Cognitive Services
- **AI Engineering**: AI pipeline design, prompt engineering, multi-modal AI, NLP, conversational AI
- **Full-Stack Web Development**: React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, TailwindCSS
- **Data Engineering**: SQL Server, data pipelines, ETL processes
- **DevOps & Security**: Sophos Firewall, cloud security, CI/CD
